content.title: Irreversible Process Chain | Material States to Human Proof
content.summary: Lock one original clearly adult cook, one kitchen, one main ingredient set, one primary vessel and visible hand or tool anchors. Build at least five irreversible food states; each beat performs one clear operation and leaves visible residue, shape, color, steam or container continuity that becomes input for the next beat. Do not jump backward to whole ingredients after they are cut or cooked. Keep the same serving through plating and end with one restrained taste by the same adult.

quick_start.input_format: Lock one clearly adult original cook, one base material, tray, kitchen and hand anchors. + Apply exactly one irreversible operation per beat. + Preserve outline, residue and topping or component distribution between states. + Return the same tray after heat with plausible color, volume and texture change. + End with the same serving and one restrained taste by the same adult.
quick_start.recommended_input: Open in an original ceramic studio: one clearly adult glaze artist, cobalt apron, copper ring, labeled mineral powders, one black mortar and one white test tile share a stable workbench. Add one measured clear liquid to the retained powder, stir into a continuous slate-blue glaze and pass the same mixture through one small sieve into a marked cup; no reset to dry powder. Return the fired tile to the original workbench. The same adult tilts it once under light and runs one gloved finger along the intact edge; hold the completed material proof with no source cook, pasta, ingredients or recipe.
required_anchors: Lock one clearly adult original cook, kitchen, ingredient set, primary vessel and hand or tool anchors.
Perform exactly one irreversible operation per beat and preserve visible residue into the next.
Keep food color, quantity and container transitions plausible through cooking and plating.
End with the same plated serving and one restrained taste by the same adult.
usage_steps: Replace the example subject, setting, and surface details with an original concept.
Keep every required anchor and Creative DNA invariant causally visible.
Choose the MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 prompt and fill only the declared variable slots.
Check duration, event order, camera continuity, sound, and anti-copy constraints before generation.

creative_dna.mechanism: Lock one original clearly adult cook, one kitchen, one main ingredient set, one primary vessel and visible hand or tool anchors. Build at least five irreversible food states; each beat performs one clear operation and leaves visible residue, shape, color, steam or container continuity that becomes input for the next beat. slots.constraint: A new setting with fixed spatial anchors and no source-specific surface.
